about.en: Autheo is a decentralised internet operating system that coordinates compute, storage, databases, APIs and messaging across a distributed mesh, with its own Layer 1 chain used for settlement, identity, governance and auditability. THEO is its utility token, used for identity, application infrastructure and ecosystem participation; it trades as an ERC-20 on Base at 0xebe516a20238F79dc20b07ead6768e08891Ed309.
